source_id: BW-RSPC-01 full path; CW-RSPC-01 rows 1, 2, 4, 6 (Dean-final approval path)
purpose: Verify the research proposal success path that ends with Dean-RSPC approval without Director action.
preconditions: Users exist holding the Faculty, HoD, RSPC Admin and Dean-RSPC roles. Faculty has a research proposal in Proposal Draft with all mandatory fields (objectives, timeline, budget, funding source, resource requirements) filled. The proposal does not meet any condition requiring Director action.
action_or_input: 1) Faculty submits the proposal. 2) HoD records a recommended outcome. 3) RSPC Admin records an eligible (complete/compliant) verification outcome. 4) Dean-RSPC records an approval.
expected_result: State after each step: 1) Proposal Submitted; 2) Department Recommended; 3) Admin Verified; 4) Approved. The proposal never enters Forwarded to Director.

source_id: BW-RSPC-02 full path; CW-RSPC-01 rows 1, 2, 4, 7, 9 (Director-routed approval path)
purpose: Verify the research proposal success path where Dean-RSPC forwards to the Director and the Director approves.
preconditions: Users exist holding the Faculty, HoD, RSPC Admin, Dean-RSPC and Director roles. Faculty has a research proposal in Proposal Draft with all mandatory fields filled. The proposal meets the represented condition requiring Director action (e.g. high-value/significant request).
action_or_input: 1) Faculty submits the proposal. 2) HoD records a recommended outcome. 3) RSPC Admin records an eligible verification outcome. 4) Dean-RSPC forwards the proposal to the Director. 5) Director records an approved outcome.
expected_result: State after each step: 1) Proposal Submitted; 2) Department Recommended; 3) Admin Verified; 4) Forwarded to Director (not Approved); 5) Approved.

purpose: Verify the department-review decision outcome where the HoD does not recommend the research proposal.
preconditions: Users exist holding the Faculty and HoD roles. A research proposal has been submitted by Faculty and is in Proposal Submitted.
action_or_input: HoD records a not-recommended outcome on the proposal.
expected_result: Proposal state becomes Department Not Recommended; it does not become Department Recommended, Admin Verified or Approved.

purpose: Verify the admin-verification decision outcome where the research proposal is not eligible for forwarding.
preconditions: Users exist holding the Faculty, HoD and RSPC Admin roles. A research proposal has been submitted and recommended by the HoD (state Department Recommended).
action_or_input: RSPC Admin records a verification outcome that is not eligible for forwarding (incomplete/non-compliant).
expected_result: Proposal state becomes Not Eligible for Forwarding; it does not become Admin Verified and is not available for Dean-RSPC decision.

purpose: Verify the Dean-RSPC decision outcome where the research proposal is not approved.
preconditions: Users exist holding the Faculty, HoD, RSPC Admin and Dean-RSPC roles. A research proposal has been submitted, recommended and admin-verified (state Admin Verified).
action_or_input: Dean-RSPC records a not-approved decision on the proposal.
expected_result: Proposal state becomes Dean Not Approved; it does not become Approved or Forwarded to Director.

purpose: Verify the Director decision outcome where a forwarded research proposal is not approved.
preconditions: Users exist holding the Faculty, HoD, RSPC Admin, Dean-RSPC and Director roles. A research proposal has been submitted, recommended, admin-verified and forwarded to the Director by Dean-RSPC (state Forwarded to Director).
action_or_input: Director records a not-approved decision on the proposal.
expected_result: Proposal state becomes Director Not Approved; it does not become Approved.
